svg.title: Sixteen pots, drawn as we expect experiment 1 to end
svg.desc: Sixteen pots of pale Mars simulant in four groups of four, each drawn with the radish that grew in it. Group A, fed nitrate with chlorate added, has tiny wilted seedlings, because the enzyme is wrecked and the nitrogen cannot be used. Group B, fed nitrate with no poison, has full healthy radishes. Group C, fed ammonium with chlorate added, is highlighted and has radishes nearly as good as group B, because ammonium does not need the wrecked enzyme. Group D, fed nitrate with perchlorate added, is between the two, because the plant's own enzyme largely ignores perchlorate.
svg.text: Experiment 1, drawn as we expect it to end
Sixteen pots of Mars simulant. Pot C is the whole experiment.
